summary: Lolo NF lookout 2 miles northeast of Lolo Pass, Missoula County, MT: a 20-foot platform tower built in 1917 and abandoned by 1930; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned by 1930 per firelookout.com; the Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists it as Platform Gone.

events.note: 20-foot platform tower built in 1917, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: built in 1917 as a 20-foot platform tower; abandoned by 1930
evidence.quote: This 20' platform tower, built in 1917, was abandoned by 1930.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Built (1917) and abandoned (by 1930) dates come from one detailed listing (firelookout.com); the FFLA index only confirms it is gone. The roughly 1,100-foot comparison in the story is our arithmetic from the lookout's listed 6,360 feet and the Wikipedia pass elevation of 5,233 feet. The firelookout.com record shows R.I.P. 1917-? so the end date is unknown. Two searches and a Montana History Portal check found no staffing, fire, structure or photo record for this site. Nothing in the sources describes what remains or whether the public may visit.
